sections.changelog: v1.2.97: Reintroduces post-v1.2.93 feature work in a verified, syntax-valid state. Includes robust settings local storage fallbacks, visibility triggers to hide the FAB speed-dial when any panel is open, modules settings panel deactivation tab to turn off css_studio/mimams_bar/content_studio/media_studio, Mimam's Bar asset enqueuing bypass, and centered widescreen layout upgrades for Content Studio and Media Studio.
